funnelTitle: Funnel has opened this port to the public internet
funnelDescription: While Funnel is on, remote access rejects every request that doesn't come from this PC. Turn Funnel off in a terminal (tailscale funnel reset or tailscale funnel --https=443 off) and publish to your tailnet only.

title: Remote access
description: Use this PC's agent from a phone browser connected through Tailscale.
warningTitle: A connected device can run the agent on this PC
warningDescription: The agent edits files and runs programs on this PC. Connect only your own devices, and disconnect any you no longer use.

guide.heading: How to connect
guide.step1: On the PC, use Install Tailscale below; on your phone, install Tailscale from the app store and sign in with the same account.
guide.step2: Turn on Allow remote access below.
guide.step3: Click Publish with Tailscale to open this PC at its Tailscale address (HTTPS).
guide.step4: Click Connect device, scan the QR code with your phone camera, then tap Open PC on the guide page that opens. Connect Phone in the header does all of this in one go.
guide.step5: Use Add to Home screen in your phone browser's menu to open it like an app.

installIntro: Downloads the official installer from pkgs.tailscale.com, verifies it, and installs it. Windows asks for administrator permission once during installation.
signInWatch: Finish signing in to Tailscale in your browser and this screen continues on its own.
httpsPending: HTTPS isn't enabled on the tailnet yet. Click Allow on the page opened in your browser and this screen continues on its own.
enableFirst: Turn on remote access before connecting a device.
scanHint: Scan the QR code with your phone camera and tap Open PC on the guide page. You can also enter the code by hand.
codeExpired: The code has expired. Click Connect device again to create a new one.
deviceExpired: Expired · Unused for 30 days; connect it again

phone.title: Connect phone
phone.description: Use this PC's agent from a phone browser connected through Tailscale. Connect only your own devices.
phone.setupIntro: The button below installs and signs in to Tailscale, turns on remote access, and publishes to your tailnet, one step after another. If a browser or Windows prompt appears along the way, follow it.
phone.afterBrowser: Finish in the browser and this window continues on its own.
phone.manualIntro: The app can't install Tailscale on this PC. Install and sign in to Tailscale from the download page, then click Try again.
phone.scanInstruction: Scan it with your phone camera and tap 'Open PC'. If you don't have Tailscale, that page will guide you.
phone.sameAddress: Check that the phone guide page shows the same address.
phone.rotatesIn: A new code replaces this one in {{time}} · Single use
